claims.claim: DVPD uses a dual-branch predictive/diffusion architecture that treats spectrograms as both acoustic frequency-domain structures and visual textures (Figure 1; Figure 2).
The FANC encoder preserves low-frequency harmonics while pruning high-frequency redundancy using frequency-adaptive non-uniform compression (Section 3.3).
claims.scope: measured resolution and compute allocation per band

claims.claim: DVPD attains state-of-the-art speech enhancement quality on WSJ0-UNI while using 35% of PGUSE parameters and 40% of PGUSE inference MACs (Table 1).
claims.reason: requires faithful full-scale DVPD and PGUSE implementations trained and evaluated on WSJ0-UNI; the small model here is not comparable, and no enhancement-quality metric on real speech exists in this package

claims.claim: Training only on WSJ0-UNI, DVPD generalizes across multiple out-of-distribution speech enhancement benchmarks better than compared predictive and diffusion baselines (Figure 5).
claims.reason: requires training on WSJ0-UNI and evaluating on the OOD benchmark suite; not feasible in this CPU-only package

claims.claim: DVPD improves over compared methods on VBDMD speech denoising and VBDMD-SR speech super-resolution evaluations (Table 2; Table 3).
claims.reason: requires the VBDMD and VBDMD-SR corpora and trained baselines; not available to this package

claims.claim: Ablations show that FANC, the frequency-aware interaction module, LISA, and the TLB strategy each contribute to DVPD performance (Table 4; Table 5).
claims.scope: toy-scale trained ablation of three of four components; TLB is not wired into this package's forward pass and could not be ablated

evidence.tlb_note: TLBStrategy exists in this package but is not connected to the forward pass; its ablation cannot be trained here

claims.observation: at toy scale, removing no_interaction, no_lisa worsens held-out MSE (supporting their contribution), while removing uniform_encoder improves it - the FANC contribution claim is not supported at this scale; TLB could not be ablated

provenance: all numbers computed by generate_evidence.py with pinned seeds; fabricated MACs figure and prose-verified benchmark claims removed 2026-08-01
